org_ref.name: Park People
org_ref.mission: Park People works to advance city parks as essential spaces to connect people to each other and the rest of nature. They envision a Canada where everyone has access to a vibrant park where people and the rest of nature thrive.
org_ref.description: Park People is the only national, bilingual organization dedicated to championing city parks in Canada. It collaborates with community leaders, non-profit park organizations, and park professionals to realize the potential of urban green spaces for connecting people and nature across the country.

job_ref.title: HR & Admin Coordinator
job_ref.summary_ref: This HR & Admin Coordinator role supports the Finance, Admin, and HR teams at TREC and its clients by managing HR logistics, coordinating recruitment, handling office administration, and assisting with financial tasks, ideally within a non-profit context.
